name: massCode
description: In the reviewed massCode updater module, electron-updater is configured with automatic download disabled and installation-on-quit enabled; checks run on startup and periodically, with a confirmation path for downloads. The source review does not establish effective SHA-512 or macOS notarization enforcement for released artifacts.
limitations: The snapshot does not establish released artifact signing or notarization.
electron-updater internals are not vendored in the application source.
